text:
incident-bot: P0 ALERT — multiple Private VPC customers reporting 5xx from model endpoints across eu-west1 / eu-central1. Auto-paged on-call. Pager: dave-oncall.

elaine-sre: acked. seeing increased 502/503 spikes in frontends for private-vpc routes, only for requests coming from EU regions. Hosted API and dedicated customers in same regions seem fine.

michael-netops: I'm seeing ILB health checks flapping for backends in europe. control-plane shows forwarding rule steals to other region and then drops. suspect cross-region forwarding regression in GCP ILB mesh.

jin-eng: logs from runtime show repeated `EOF` / `connection reset by peer` on h2 streams. No sign of model failures. Backend instances healthy from within region.

sam-customer-success: we already have 3 support tickets: customers A, B, C reporting "model calls failing" and one has active customers in production. Need ETA and mitigation plan to call out.

dave-oncall: paging GCP support now. creating incident bridge. oncall handoff in 30m — ops-rotations will take second shift.

michael-netops: creating a GCP SR: https://console.cloud.google.com/support/cases/CASE-12345 (GCP ticket created). Noted they have a reported ILB control plane issue affecting forwarding between regions for Shared VPC.

gcp-support-bot: GCP CASE-12345: We have an ongoing internal investigation into cross-region forwarding regression affecting internal LBs. Engineers have rolled a mitigation candidate to a subset and will advise.

elaine-sre: mitigation options we can take now: 1) steer EU customer traffic to hosted public endpoints (TLS, no ILB), 2) route EU to Dedicated EU capacity (if customer has it), 3) emergency reroute inside customer's VPC (if they accept config change). Which is fastest?

sam-customer-success: contacting customers now, offering staged fallback to hosted API for impacted tenants. Request permission to update customer configs where we manage routing.

jin-eng: technical note — switching to hosted removes ILB hop; requests will go over public internet but encrypted. There may be slight latency bump (~30–80ms) but it avoids internal LB path. We can flip routing at the Redwood Router/policy layer in ~5–10 minutes per rollout.

michael-netops: I can remove the ILB forwarding rule for the EU routes to force external egress path, but that risks other customers. Prefer policy-based steering from platform.

dave-oncall: action: elaine to flip policy for `private-vpc:eu-*` -> `fallback:hosted`. michael to hold on manual LB changes until GCP confirms. jin to monitor runtime errors. sam to notify customers with PSAT. ops-rotations stands by for handoff.

elaine-sre: executing traffic policy change now. command: `redwoodctl routing update --selector \"env:private-vpc,region:eu\" --target hosted-fallback --dry-run=false`

jin-eng: seeing routing changes apply. logs show new connections to public ingress. error-rate for impacted prefixes dropping from ~18% -> ~5% in first 2 mins.

sam-customer-success: customer A confirmed partial recovery, still seeing occasional 502s for long-lived streams. asking if we can do sticky fallbacks for streaming connections.

jin-eng: streaming sticky sessions will require graceful drain of old ILB connections. We should trigger drain on backends: `gcloud compute backend-services update-backend BACKEND --global --balancing-mode CONNECTION` and set `drainTimeout`. I can coordinate but prefer to keep changes minimal.

michael-netops: GCP update: they have isolated a route programming bug in the ILB control plane impacting Shared VPCs with custom route advertisement. They aim to push a fix to all affected projects in next 90 mins.

ops-rotations: taking over on-call. leaving notes: monitor GCP CASE-12345, verify `forwardingRules` and `healthChecks` stability, keep policy fallback enabled until GCP confirms.

dave-oncall: handing incident to ops-rotations. I'll be reachable if things regress.

gcp-support-bot: Update CASE-12345: mitigation rollouts are starting; affected customers should see <1% errors once rollout finishes. We'll post when fix is fully deployed.

elaine-sre: production checks: synthetic probes for Private VPC endpoints across eu-west1 and eu-central1 now show 99.85% success after policy fallback. Logging shows residual 502s for older TCP connections only.

sam-customer-success: sent customer notice: short explanation + temporary mitigation + ETA for full resolution. customers with strict egress policies asked for exception guidance.

jin-eng: added temporary playbook snippet to runbook: 
```
# Quick fallback to hosted for Private VPC EU
1. `redwoodctl routing update --selector \"env:private-vpc,region:eu\" --target hosted-fallback --dry-run=false`
2. Monitor `platform.proxies.*.errors` and `platform.synthetics.eu.*`
3. Revert after GCP confirms fix
```

michael-netops: GCP now reports fix fully rolled out to affected projects. They recommend we revert policy only after 60 minutes of post-fix stability.

elaine-sre: starting gradual revert in 15m, will do canary on subset of customers first. canary command: `redwoodctl routing update --selector \"customer:canary-eu\" --target private-vpc --rate 5%`

jin-eng: canary looks stable at 5% for 10m, error rate = 0.1%. increasing to 25% now.

ops-rotations: increasing to 50% per rollback plan. monitoring traces for connection resets.

dave-oncall: reverting full now. initiating global switch to original private-vpc routing.

jin-eng: after full revert, synthetic probes show errors back to baseline (<=0.05%). long-lived streams re-established.

sam-customer-success: all impacted customers notified of resolution and timeline. one customer asked for postmortem; collecting logs and timeline.

elaine-sre: closing bridge. root cause: GCP ILB cross-region forwarding programming regression in Shared VPC control plane impacting internal forwarding rules; impact limited to Private VPC traffic that traversed cross-region ILB mesh. Mitigation: platform-level routing fallback to hosted endpoints. Action items: 1) postmortem writeup + RCA, 2) add automated fallback runbook to oncall playbook, 3) ask sales/account to get opt-in for hosted fallback for customers with tight SLAs, 4) follow up with GCP for preventative guardrails.

ops-rotations: leaving incident note for SRE rotation: `INCIDENT-1790123456` assigned.

incident-bot: INCIDENT CLOSED — service restored and monitoring stable.
